ZHANG Fei-yan, FENG Shan, XU Xiao-yu Pharmacy college, Southwest University, Chongqing 400716, China Abstract: In recent years, the Chinese medicine Salvia miltiorrhiza has been widely used in cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. So, the interaction between S. miltiorrhiza and cytochrome P450s are focused increasingly. This review summarized the research progress on the cytochrome P450s-based metabolism and interaction of S. miltiorrhiza, including its extracts, major individuals, and S. miltiorrhiza-based formulas. It systematically summarized the information which were useful for the further applications and researches on S. miltiorrhiza and its active components.丹参为唇形科植物丹参 Salvia miltiorrhiza Bunge的干燥根及根茎，含有脂溶性和水溶性成分。
